findings.text: Provides a request that targets one CPU interface with a software interrupt number; caller supplies interface index and interrupt number and implementation routes the request through the primary distributor.
Provides a query that converts a logical CPU number into its interface position, reporting failure when the number is out of supported range or the stored mapping is not a single interface bit.

Provides a migration operation that re-targets shared peripheral interrupts from the invoking processor to a new processor and forwards any pending software interrupts addressed to the invoker toward the new interface.
Provides access to the physical address of the software interrupt trigger register, returning zero while the distributor base has not been captured.

Provides a child initialization helper for a cascaded controller that allocates controller state, maps bases, builds its interrupt domain, associates power management ownership and installs a chained handler.
Secondary CPU startup entry installs the CPU interface state for the primary controller and reports success.
Device-tree probe entry for each controller instance validates limits, maps registers, decides split deactivation mode, builds bases, and wires cascade and message extensions when present.
Affinity programming is accepted only on the primary distributor; selection respects online processors unless forced, rejects out-of-range targets, and records the effective single processor result.

Inter-processor signalling distinguishes single processor self delivery from multi processor fan-out; the latter aggregates logical targets into a physical mask under lock and orders prior memory visibility before triggering on the primary distributor.

Interrupt domain mapping selects the split deactivation operation set only when that mode is active and the domain belongs to the primary controller; low hardware numbers become per-processor interrupts while higher numbers become shared single-target interrupts with context enforcement.

Firmware description translation accepts three shapes: single software interrupt number, device-tree triple distinguishing shared versus private ranges with sensitivity, and generic irqchip pair; malformed shapes or missing sensitivity are rejected or flagged.

Base initialization supports two register layouts: per-processor banked offsets for fragmented hardware versus shared common bases; interrupt count derives from the controller count register capped at its architectural maximum.

Primary controller startup preinitializes every interface mapping to all-ones, installs the top-level interrupt handler, announces split mode when active, and performs multiprocessing setup after base construction.

Power management initialization without support is a successful no-op, while the full variant allocates per-processor save areas for private enable, active and configuration state and registers its notifier only for the primary instance.
Builds without symmetric multiprocessing disable bringup, affinity control and masked signalling by replacing them with empty or null operations.

Byte granular distributor updates on interconnects lacking sub-word writes are serialized by a dedicated static spinlock held with interrupts saved across the read-modify-write of the containing word.
Construction of the physical target mask and the trigger write for cross-processor signalling occur atomically under the distributor lock with interrupts saved.
Retargeting of shared interrupts and the update of the invoking processor mapping occur under the distributor lock, while pending software interrupt draining and re-issue proceed after release.

Power transitions drive save versus restore: processor suspend saves processor state and resume restores it, while cluster suspend saves distributor state and resume restores it; failed suspend entry also restores; handler always reports success.

Distributor restore reinstates private active and configuration state, repopulates private priorities with the default value, reinstalls the processor priority mask threshold and brings the processor interface up.
Two operation tables share most handlers and flags but differ in naming, masking and end-of-interrupt handling and in optional virtualization versus diagnostic hooks.
ACPI boot state aggregates the uniform processor interface base, maintenance interrupt number and sensitivity, and virtualization control and processor base addresses.
Domain hierarchy operations bind translation, allocation and top-layer release for managed interrupt numbers.
Byte update must align the target address down to a word boundary and shift the value according to the low address bits; incorrect alignment would corrupt neighboring distributor bytes.

Processor interface probing must tolerate firmware that exposes a truncated or aliased register window; misdetection risks using wrong offsets for deactivation and requires explicit force probing and remapping with warnings.
ACPI processor entries must all report the same interface base because non-banked layouts lack support; divergent bases and malformed entries are rejected.
Private interrupt save sizes cover thirty-two private interrupts with enable and active bitmaps packed per thirty-two and configuration packed per sixteen.

Hardware numbering reserves values below sixteen for software interrupts, offsets shared peripheral base by thirty-two and private base by sixteen, and caps total sources at one thousand twenty with eight software signals reserved for multiprocessing.
Distributor uses firmware resource zero and processor interface uses resource one, while virtualization uses resources two and three and maintenance or cascade uses interrupt index zero.
Quirk handling enables read-modify-write affinity access only on a specific compatible machine while registering under the generic byte-access quirk identifier.
Virtualization info publication requires a valid maintenance interrupt, valid control windows, and active split deactivation mode, and records the primary processor base.
Physical base capture from firmware resource zero is performed only for the first controller and is skipped in builds without that support.
Teardown safely handles absent mappings and null controller references, unmapping only present windows.
Power-device association is a no-op for null domains and otherwise records the owning device.
Device-tree register setup maps distributor and processor windows, defaults the per-processor offset to zero when absent, applies quirks, and releases mappings on failure.
ACPI parsing validates entry bounds, enforces uniform interface base across processors, captures maintenance and virtualization addresses, and marks assignment completed.
A boolean boot parameter controls whether truncated version-two windows are force-probed, parsed as a boolean value.

Multiprocessing initialization installs a dedicated hotplug step and reserves a contiguous block of eight software interrupts for inter-processor signalling, aborting reservation on allocation failure.
